scope: Visual publication review of rendered PDF pages and plot exports; scientific and formal evidence is recorded separately.
review_method: Rendered every page using Poppler and inspected at readable resolution. Independent Astra reviewers checked main pages 1–7 and appendix/references pages 8–17; the primary reviewer rechecked the final category-label and numeric-tick changes on pages 6 and 16.

findings_resolved.issue: Legends covered CPU bars and the summary-upload curve.
findings_resolved.change: Place all Matplotlib legends below data panels and reserve space at the manuscript width.

findings_resolved.issue: Small or crowded category, tick, and panel labels.
findings_resolved.change: Render plots at 6.75 inches with 8.5-point labels; wrap categories, align rotated labels, show measured context lengths, and use integer head/layer ticks.

findings_resolved.issue: Equation tags dropped below long displays or sat beside awkward continuations.
findings_resolved.change: Use aligned and split displays, redistribute sums, and keep related theorem statements and equations together.

findings_resolved.issue: TikZ endpoint strokes near zero obscured the strict-sign interpretation.
findings_resolved.change: Use precise interval caps and thin endpoint strokes; align curve labels and panel headings.

findings_resolved.issue: Stretched paragraph spacing, floats before their topic, and text fragments across figure pages.
findings_resolved.change: Use natural paragraph spacing, a single-column appendix, topic barriers, and intact short blocks beside related figures.

findings_resolved.issue: Uneven reference columns and excessive breaks inside hostnames.
findings_resolved.change: Balance the bibliography and allow URL breaks at separators and revision digits.

limitations: Visual judgment complements the geometric checks; page bounds alone cannot detect every overlap or reading-order issue.
